crossRefs.note: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you…
“If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;
He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

translations.web: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
translations.bsb: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
translations.kjv: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand
translations.asv: Thou hast beset me behind and before, And laid thy hand upon me.
